subject: Errors in running multiple simultaneous job in parallel with packrat project

messages.author: 61221ab1f726dce8
messages.subject: Errors in running multiple simultaneous job in parallel with packrat project
parts:
Hi,

I have a project under packrat control and it works all fine. But what I've noticed is if I initiate several simultaneously R jobs all the same time (e.g. using Make) that all depend on the packrat R repository I start to see some weird errors. For example,
  1. Complains certain packages do not exist (e.g. package ‘stats’ in options("defaultPackages") was not found)
  2. Some packages seem to load in different orders?
It appears to be packrat related I believe because I've tried:
  • Re-running the jobs with parallelization sometimes solves the issue, but then other files are affected. So it appears to be random.
  • Running the jobs in serial with no issues
  • Removing the project from packrat control and re-launching with parallelization leads to no errors
Could there be some packrat locking mechanism or loading mechanism that is causing issues when running jobs in parallel that use the packrat repository?

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Errors in running multiple simultaneous job in parallel with packrat project
parts:
Hi,

This is likely packrat's fault as you've diagnosed. As part of the R session startup, packrat will remove and then restore symlinks to packages within the system folder -- it is possible that, if multiple R processes are started within a folder, there will be collisions (as one process attempts to remove the symlinks while another attempts to read it).

The symlink removal is done to ensure that the appropriate R versions are symlinked in, but this report means we will need to think a bit more carefully about how this is done. I'll try to implement a fix for this soon.

Thanks,
Kevin
